enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Remain asleep. Wake up at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up to start the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, filling a water bottle for the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and plate. Place on counter. Open drawer. Take out knife. Spread butter on bread. Pour milk into bowl. Add cereal. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Fill water bottle from tap. Place water bottle in bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study materials, laptop and notes into bag and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Put on clothes. Open desk drawer. Take out laptop. Take out charger. Take out notebooks. Take out pens. Place items in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up backpack. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash University campus for classes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Put on headphones. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to campus. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education lectures and seminars on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open note-taking app. Type notes. Listen to lecturer. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Continue typing. Check phone. Get up. Walk to next class. Enter seminar room. Sit down. Take out notebook. Write notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Having lunch on campus and resting in a shaded cool area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay at cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Clear tray. Walk to shaded area. Sit on bench. Close eyes. Rest. Check phone. Walk to next class.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending tutorials and doing library research for coursework assignments
enriched_activities.desc: Enter tutorial room. Sit down. Take out laptop. Open laptop. Participate in tutorial. Take notes. Ask questions. Listen to instructor. Pack up. Walk to library. Enter library. Find study spot. Sit down. Open laptop. Search library database. Read articles. Take notes. Borrow books. Check out books. Walk to next class.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from campus in the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Wipe sweat with tissue. Drink water from bottle. Fan self with hand. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off cooker. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to recover from the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust temperature to cool. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting and checking messages and study notices on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Reply to messages. Open email app. Read study notices. Close email. Open social media. Scroll. Put down phone. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying readings and drafting assignments on computer with the air conditioner running
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on couch. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Open document. Read readings. Take notes. Type assignment. Save document. Check references. Open web browser. Search for sources. Copy citations. Paste into document. Format document. Save again. Close laptop. Turn off air conditioner.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with phone and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Watch video. Close social media. Open music app. Play music. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Fall asleep.
